newsitem.title: CANADA: EnerMark, Quest agree to merge.
newsitem.headline: EnerMark, Quest agree to merge.

text.p: Royalty trust EnerMark Income Fund and Quest Oil & Gas Inc said on Thursday they agreed to merge in a C$140 million deal.
Under the deal, Quest securityholders would receive C$2.35 per share and C$0.15 per warrant in cash or EnerMark trust units, the companies said.
Quest financial adviser Newcrest Capital Inc ruled the proposal was fair to Quest shareholders from a financial point of view, the firms said.
Quest's board recommended shareholders accept the offer.
The deal's total value was based on Quest's 50.7 million shares and 7.7 million outstanding warrants plus Quest's debt.

EnerMark, which was reorganized last year into a royalty trust out of the assets of struggling exploration and production company Mark Resources, said Quest holders opting for the share swap would receive an amount based on the cash consideration divided by the average trading price of EnerMark units for 10 days before April 10.
The offer document was expected to be mailed on Friday and a special meeting of Quest shareholders to vote on the arrangement was slated for April 18, the firms said.
